d: Calo is an app providing personalized meal plans for busy people through nutritional algorithms, built with love by chefs, nutritionists, and software engineers.

Launched in Bahrain in 2019, we have since expanded to 6 countries, delivered millions of meals to our customers, and are now expanding our mission of making healthy easy to retail and other verticals.
We're on a noble mission to make healthy easy. We think this is one of the most important problems to tackle in our world today. We have global ambitions - no small thinking here.

You’ll play a key role in bringing Calo’s brand and campaigns to life across our paid and organic channels. From shaping creative briefs and coordinating shoots to managing content calendars and reviewing final assets, you’ll help ensure we consistently deliver high-quality, engaging content that reflects our brand and supports our business goals.
q: 1–3 years of experience in content, social media, creative production, marketing, or a related field.
Experience working across both organic and paid content.
Strong understanding of social media content formats, trends, and platform best practices.
Experience coordinating content production, shoots, creators, agencies, or other external partners.
Strong creative eye with an understanding of graphic design, visual identity, and brand consistency.
Good understanding of video editing and content production workflows.
Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and stakeholders.
Comfortable working with content performance data and reporting dashboards.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Someone who naturally spots what makes content engaging and on-brand.
Comfortable taking ownership and driving projects from brief to execution.
Organized and able to manage multiple content pieces, deadlines, and stakeholders at once.
Collaborative and comfortable working with designers, creators, agencies, and cross-functional teams.
Proactive, hands-on, and willing to jump in wherever needed to get great content out.
Data-aware and interested in using performance insights to continuously improve content.
Fast-moving and adaptable, with the ability to thrive in a dynamic environment.
Screening meeting with our TA team
r: Brief and direct content internally and with external partners/agencies across paid and organic channels
Own always-on content output, ensuring consistent quality and brand alignment
Translate campaign objectives into clear creative and content briefs
Plan, coordinate, and conduct shoots end-to-end (briefing, logistics, on-set direction, wrap-up)
Manage the content posting calendar and scheduling across platforms
Ensure timely delivery and publishing of content across all channels
Develop static creative assets in collaboration with the central design team
Bring a strong eye for graphic design with a deep understanding of visual/brand standards, even without hands-on design execution
Have an eye for editing and contribute directly to video/content edits where needed
Review and QC creative output before it goes live
Track and report on content performance inform content decisions
Build working knowledge of reporting tools/dashboards to self-serve insights

d: Radisson Hotel Group is one of the world's largest hotel groups with ten distinctive hotel brands, and more than 1,500 hotels in operation and under development in 95+ countries. The Group’s overarching brand promise is Every Moment Matters with a signature Yes I Can! service ethos.

People are at the core of our business success and future. Our people are true Moment Makers and together we bring the culture, spirit, environment and opportunities that empower you to be your best, every day, everywhere, every time. Together, we make Every Moment Matter.
Are you ready to elevate the guest experience from check-in to check-out and everything in-between? Say Yes I Can! and be a part of our dynamic world of Moment Makers.

We are currently seeking a Receptionist to join our vibrant team. At Radisson Hotel Group, we are in search of individuals who go beyond the resume – those with character, skills, talents, and a passion for creating memorable experiences.

As a Receptionist you bring an unmatched level of dedication, a focus on delivering exceptional service, and a genuine passion for creating positive guest experiences to our dynamic Front Office Team.
Our Receptionists love the hustle and bustle of life! It’s not just about check-in and check-out. It’s about everything in-between
You will be our guests’ superhero ensuring all aspects of the guest journey and experience are delivered to the highest level
You will exude patience, empathy and have the personality to host the show
Welcome guests warmly and provide a professional, personalized check-in and check-out experience.
Handle guest registration, room assignments, key issuance, and departure procedures efficiently.
Respond & manage to guest inquiries, complaints, and concerns promptly regarding hotel facilities, services, room amenities, and local attractions.
Coordinate closely with Housekeeping, Reservations, Concierge, and other departments to ensure seamless guest experiences.
Maintain accurate guest information, billing records, cash handling, and payment transactions.
Ensure all arrivals, departures, room status updates, and guest profiles are properly updated in the hotel system.
Maintain confidentiality of guest information and adhere to hotel security procedures.
Ensure compliance with RHG brand standards, service procedures, and departmental policies.
Maintain a professional appearance, Yes I Can! positive attitude, and courteous communication at all times.
q: Flexibility and a positive, Yes I Can! Attitude
Previous experience in Front Office, Guest Services or a similar role within the hospitality industry.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a guest-focused attitude.
Excellent customer service and problem-solving abilities.
Good knowledge of hotel operations and Front Office procedures.
Professional appearance with a positive and friendly personality.
Ability to work independently and effectively within a multicultural team.
Strong organisational skills with the ability to multitask and work under pressure.
Flexibility to work shifts, weekends and public holidays as required

d: We are seeking an experienced, results-driven Marketing Manager to lead the marketing function of a newly established specialized healthcare center and drive its brand awareness, patient acquisition, and sustainable growth.
This is an exciting opportunity for a hands-on marketing professional to shape the center’s brand and marketing strategy from the launch stage.
Develop and execute marketing strategies, launch plans, and brand positioning.
Lead digital marketing campaigns across social media, search engines, and other relevant channels.
Drive patient inquiries, appointment bookings, and attendance through measurable campaigns.
Oversee brand identity, content creation, and bilingual marketing communications.
Manage external marketing agencies, campaign budgets, and performance.
Monitor marketing KPIs, campaign effectiveness, and return on investment.
Collaborate with physicians, clinical teams, and operations to promote healthcare services effectively.
Ensure marketing activities comply with applicable Saudi healthcare advertising and patient privacy requirements.
Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
5–8 years of progressive marketing experience, preferably within hospitals, specialized medical centers, polyclinics, or outpatient healthcare providers.
Proven experience in launching or growing healthcare services and generating measurable patient acquisition results.
Strong knowledge of digital marketing, social media advertising, search marketing, analytics, and CRM/lead-tracking tools.
Experience managing marketing agencies, budgets, and multi-channel campaigns.
Good understanding of the Saudi healthcare market.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Arabic and English.

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

The Project Manager will operate within a multidisciplinary design consultancy environment, responsible for the successful delivery of complex Data Centre projects across the region. The role requires leadership of integrated design teams across architecture, building engineering, specialist disciplines, infrastructure, utilities and master planning, ensuring coordinated, high-quality design solutions that meet client, regulatory and project requirements.

This is a client-facing role that requires strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills. The successful candidate will manage projects through all phases of delivery, ensuring objectives are achieved safely, efficiently, and in accordance with client requirements, quality standards, and business objectives.
q: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.
Minimum 7 years of project management experience within a design practice
Experience of managing Data Centre projects through multiple phases of delivery.
Strong client-facing experience, preferably within a consultancy, engineering, or project delivery environment.
Experience coordinating multidisciplinary project teams and multiple stakeholders.
Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
Strong understanding of project management principles, governance, and reporting processes.
Experience managing project schedules, budgets, risks, and quality requirements.
Proven track record of delivering projects successfully and meeting client expectations.
Professional certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent would be advantageous.
Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 70,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.
r: Manage the delivery of Data Centre projects from initiation through to completion.
Act as a key point of contact for clients, maintaining effective working relationships and regular communication.
Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, budgets, and resource plans.
Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary teams to ensure efficient and integrated project delivery.
Monitor project progress and performance against agreed objectives and deliverables.
Identify, manage, and mitigate project risks and issues.
Facilitate design coordination across internal and externally appointed subconsultants and subject matter experts.
Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, standards, health and safety requirements, and client expectations.
Support coordination with stakeholders, authorities, contractors, consultants, and other third parties
Support design assurance and technical governance processes.
Assist in securing necessary approvals, permits, and stakeholder agreements where required.
Review project deliverables to ensure adherence to quality standards and project requirements.
Prepare project reports and provide accurate updates to clients and internal stakeholders.
Support commercial management activities, including cost control, change management, and contract administration.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and the development of project management best practices.
